questions.question: When and where was the sulfa allergy first recorded, and what reaction was documented at that time?
Which specific sulfa drug was involved in the prior reaction, and what were the details of that event?

Were any sulfa-containing medications prescribed or administered since the allergy was documented?
Have other drug allergies or intolerances been recorded elsewhere in the chart?
